CustomField.description: REV-60: when true, this row's base is a non-deterministic DEFAULT the rep can override — the engine fills it only on a blank line and never overwrites a value the rep set. Used for the WNS !SREN default (a WNS renewal can legitimately be !SJSI or !SREN, so the rep's choice always wins).
CustomField.label: Write On Blank Only
